settings.heading: Bridal Makeup
settings.body: Congratulations on your engagement — I'd be honoured to be part of your wedding day.

settings.heading: Maggie Tamarua
settings.lede: Maggie is an award-winning bridal makeup artist with several consecutive Australian Bridal Industry Awards, bringing years of professional experience and a calm, supportive approach to every bride. She listens closely to your vision and translates it into a personalised, timeless look that makes you feel confident and beautiful. Planning and getting ready can feel overwhelming — she'll guide you through trials, timelines and on-the-day styling to ensure a relaxed, memorable morning.
settings.image_alt: Maggie Tamarua, award-winning bridal makeup artist

settings.text: Makeup Artist of the Year — ABIA Awards 2013 & 2014
Featured in Vogue, Girlfriend Magazine & Melbourne Bridal & Fashion World
Trained with Napoleon in 2004 — two decades behind the brush

settings.heading: Packages & Booking
settings.lede: Packages start from $1200. Enquire to receive Maggie's full bridal offerings, current availability and a quote built around your day.

settings.heading: What's Included
settings.items:
- Personal consultation to plan the look around your dress, hair and schedule.
- Skin prep with long-wear products chosen for a full day of photography.
- False lashes, individual or strip, to suit your eye shape.
- A running order agreed with you and your photographer before the morning.
- Touch-up guidance so you can keep the look fresh through the day.

settings.heading: The Trial
settings.items:
- Held at the studio, usually 6 to 8 weeks before the wedding.
- Bring inspiration images, your veil or hair pieces, and a top in a similar tone to your dress.
- Photographed in daylight so you can see the finish the way a camera will.
- Notes and product list kept on file for the morning.

settings.heading: Travel & Locations
settings.items:
- Maggie comes to your getting-ready address.
- Melbourne metro included; regional and interstate quoted on enquiry.
- Early starts accommodated where the timeline needs one.
- Tell us the address in your enquiry and it will be confirmed with your quote.

settings.heading: On the Day
settings.items:
- A timeline built backwards from your ceremony and photographer's arrival.
- Bride finished last so the makeup is at its freshest for photographs.
- A calm, unhurried room from first face to last.
- Kit on hand for any final touch-ups before you leave.

settings.heading: Deposits & Payments
settings.items:
- A deposit secures your date; the balance is payable ahead of the day.
- Dates are held only once the deposit is received.
- Bookings open up to 4 months in advance for studio services; bridal dates are taken further out.

settings.heading: Cancellations & Credits
settings.items:
- Cancel at least 7 days before the appointment and the deposit becomes a credit, valid for 12 months.
- Cancellations within 7 days forfeit the deposit.
- Exceptions for documented emergencies can be considered at our discretion.

settings.heading: Recent Work
settings.lede: A sample of recent bridal work — luminous skin, a softly defined eye, and hair that holds from the first look to the last dance. No two brides are alike, so every look is built around your dress, your flowers and the way you want to feel walking down the aisle. Scroll through, save what you love, and bring it to your consultation.

settings.question: How far in advance should I book?
settings.answer: As early as you can — popular dates go first, particularly through spring and autumn. Send your date through even if the rest of the planning is still up in the air.

settings.question: Do you travel to me on the morning?
settings.answer: Yes. Maggie comes to your getting-ready address. Tell us the location in your enquiry and it will be confirmed with your quote.

settings.question: Is a trial included?
settings.answer: Trials are covered in Maggie's bridal offerings — the details come back with your enquiry so you can see exactly what each package includes.

settings.question: Can you look after my bridal party?
settings.answer: Yes. Let us know in the enquiry how many people need makeup and we'll build a timeline that gets everyone ready without a rush.

settings.question: What if I need to change or cancel my date?
settings.answer: Cancel at least 7 days before the appointment and your deposit becomes a credit valid for 12 months. Within 7 days the deposit is forfeited. Exceptions for documented emergencies can be considered at our discretion.

settings.question: How do I secure my date?
settings.answer: Send the enquiry form below. You'll receive Maggie's bridal offerings and, once you've chosen, a deposit locks the date in.
